Package qupath.ext.omero.core.apis.webgateway

Class WebGatewayApi

java.lang.Object
qupath.ext.omero.core.apis.webgateway.WebGatewayApi
All Implemented Interfaces:
AutoCloseable
public class WebGatewayApi extends Object implements AutoCloseable
API to communicate with a OMERO.gateway server.

This API is used to retrieve several icons, image thumbnails and provides access to the pixels of JPEG-compressed RGB encoded images.

An instance of this class must be closed once no longer used.

    • getThumbnail

      public CompletableFuture<BufferedImage> getThumbnail(long imageId, int size)
      Attempt to retrieve the thumbnail of an image.

      Note that exception handling is left to the caller (the returned CompletableFuture may complete exceptionally if the request failed for example).

      Thumbnails are cached in a cache of size THUMBNAIL_CACHE_SIZE.

      Parameters:
      imageId - the OMERO image ID
      size - the max width and max height the thumbnail should have
      Returns:
      a CompletableFuture (that may complete exceptionally) with the thumbnail

      Attempt to retrieve the metadata of an image.

      Note that exception handling is left to the caller (the returned CompletableFuture may complete exceptionally if the request failed for example).

      Metadata are cached in a cache of size METADATA_CACHE_SIZE.

      Parameters:

      Returns:
      a CompletableFuture (that may complete exceptionally) with the metadata

    • readTile

      public CompletableFuture<BufferedImage> readTile(long imageId, qupath.lib.images.servers.TileRequest tileRequest, int preferredTileWidth, int preferredTileHeight, double quality)
      Attempt to read a tile (portion of image).

      Note that exception handling is left to the caller (the returned CompletableFuture may complete exceptionally if the request or the conversion failed for example).

      Parameters:
      imageId - the OMERO image ID
      tileRequest - the tile request (usually coming from the AbstractTileableImageServer)
      preferredTileWidth - the preferred tile width in pixels
      preferredTileHeight - the preferred tile height in pixels
      quality - the JPEG quality, from 0 to 1
      Returns:
      a CompletableFuture (that may complete exceptionally) with the tile

    • changeChannelColors

      public CompletableFuture<Void> changeChannelColors(long imageId, List<Integer> newChannelColors, List<ChannelSettings> existingChannelSettings)
      Attempt to change the channel colors of an image.

      Note that exception handling is left to the caller (the returned CompletableFuture may complete exceptionally if the request or the conversion failed for example).

      Parameters:
      imageId - the ID of the image to change the channel settings
      newChannelColors - the new channel colors, with the packed RGB format
      existingChannelSettings - the existing channel settings of the image
      Returns:
      a void CompletableFuture (that completes exceptionally if the operation failed)
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - when newChannelColors and existingChannelSettings don't have the same number of elements

      newChannelSettings - the new channel display ranges (other fields of ChannelSettings will be ignored)
